# Kanji record fixtures

Hand-written test data in the canonical record format. The readings and meanings are not
production KANJIDIC2 output; the production build (commit 5) imports real data from upstream.

- `U+4E00.org` (一) has one reviewed and one draft translation.
- `U+65E5.org` (日) has no translations yet.
- `U+4E00-stale.org` has a source change without a fingerprint patch, to test the validator.
